'''Foreman Kegg Boulderboots''' is a [[Wildhammer dwarf]] quest giver located in the town of [[Dun Kithas]] in the [[Grim Reaches]]. He served as the foreman for the [[Sal'Galaz Mines]] for a good thirty years until the mine was overrun by troggs after one half of the [[Gemstone of Naraz]] was unearthed.<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|35|Reclaiming Sal'Galaz}}</ref>
